Illusive Mirage — Innate Technique (1st level)

Your technique lets you curse people and make them see illusions.

At 1st level, your technique allows you to curse creatures and make them see other people's faces in a distorted way. You are also able to track those you have cursed. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you can curse a creature within 60 feet. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the next person they see has a distorted face. Upon seeing this distortion for the first time, the creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature is confused and has disadvantage on attack rolls and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks until the end of their next turn. A sorcerer can repeat the Charisma save at the end of their turns to end the curse.
When a creature fails their Charisma saving throw, you gain the ability to track them up to 400 feet away. While a creature is cursed, you know its general location. The cursed creature keeps seeing the distorted face until they succeed the save or leave your tracking range.

At 6th level, you can target a number of creatures up to your Cursed Energy modifier as an action, spending 2 CE for each. Additionally, a creature that fails its save also has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves and loses concentration on any technique or feature it was concentrating on.
